reason: Document A includes the $11,000 pledged by three local businesses, which brings the remaining amount needed from residents down to $49,000—almost the exact amount we managed to raise in the failed campaign three years ago. Knowing the goal is actually within our town's proven reach, and seeing it broken down to $7.50 a person, convinces me that pitching in a small amount after my big hospital donation is worthwhile and will actually succeed this time.
